HOW TO USE GRINDS

Grinds pouches are a simple, safe, and effective way to feel sharper and more alert.

HOW TO USE GRINDS

Grinds pouches are a simple, safe, and effective way to feel sharper and more alert.
01

OPEN CAN. PUT POUCH IN MOUTH.

Open the can and grab a pouch. Tuck the pouch anywhere between your top lip and gum.
02

ACTIVATE FLAVOR & ENJOY.

Flavor will begin to activate in 15-30 seconds and lasts for up to one hour.
03

USE UP TO 1HR & DISCARD.

Enjoy for up to 60 minutes. Flavor intensity and duration may vary by flavor. Discard when finished.

THE STORY

From Shark Tank to Store Shelves

Grinds began because of some free pizza and a college business plan competition.

Eventually, the product found its way into the locker room of the San Francisco Giants and spread throughout MLB. Grinds went on to appear on Shark Tank and is now readily available in convenience stores nationwide.

FROM ATHLETES TO EVERYONE

Originally designed as a healthy tobacco alternative for professional baseball, Grinds quickly became a mainstream way for anyone to kick the habit.
